login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to manage events, teams and scores.

forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.description: We will email you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way.

register.title: Create an account
register.description: Create an account to sign in. An event manager gives you access to an event.
register.name: Full name

verify.success: Your email address has been verified.
verify.title: Verify your email
verify.description: We sent you a link to confirm your email address.
verify.explanation: Open the link in the email to activate your account. Until then, you cannot access events.

invitation.title: Accept invitation
invitation.welcome: Hello {name}, you are invited to {event} as {role}. Choose a password to activate your account.
invitation.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask your event manager to send it again.
invitation.invalid: This invitation link is not valid (any more). If you already activated your account, sign in.
